title: Running Through the Canvas
description: A surreal painting depicts a person in a black dress shoe and purple pants stepping out from a large framed abstract painting, leaving vibrant purple and orange paint drips and splashes across the gallery floor. The art gallery has pink walls, an arched doorway with dramatic light beams, and multiple other framed paintings visible in the background.
prompt: Surreal scene inside an art gallery with pink walls and dramatic god rays coming through an archway. A large ornate gold frame holds a vibrant abstract painting in red, green and blue. A person wearing purple pants and shiny black dress shoes is stepping out from the canvas, their lower body emerging into the room as purple and orange paint drips heavily onto the tiled floor. Multiple other framed paintings line the walls in the background. Cinematic lighting, painterly style.
